title: Saved-conversation automatic inputs: a member's message retained under the explicit automatic_v1 contract, with no effect
why: SOPHIA-INC-2026-11 INC-03 slice S01 (INC03-CC-002 S01b): the HTTP boundary for migration 0095's two writers. Its generated output is regenerated with `pnpm --filter @sophia/contracts generate`, never by hand.

New paths, not a variant of A33: the legacy ConversationStart/ConversationSend bodies (askSophia required) and their routes are unchanged, so an old client cannot opt in by accident and a new one cannot fall back to legacy Ask.

The actor is the verified token subject and the author name comes from the token. Bodies are closed: no actor, name, audience, origin, mention, reply, selection, context or askSophia field. Authority (a current admin or editor), audience, settings and revisions are resolved by the database under its locks. The same Idempotency-Key and request replays the first receipt under the caller's current authority; another request under it conflicts.

Recorded only: the message is kept once, with metadata-only input; no reply, assessment, attention, notification, outbox or work follows. Served only when the API is built with conversations and automatic inputs (both off by default).
